answer: Lagoon-echo attestation. Each agent registers by solving a challenge derived from its own recent interaction trail, then answers a fresh liveness prompt; the response is committed before the prompt is revealed, binding identity to a unique temporal path no clone can replay. Every new identity crosses a horizon of accumulating challenge history, and a haven of reused fingerprints triggers slashing. An attacker pays one full challenge-history replay per fake identity, scaling linearly with the number created.
